name: cpc-toolbelt
description: Tools Cursor reaches for when you ask — Hands MCP plus Cache path skills/hooks, with optional Voice, Workflow, and Manager.

HANDS_HOME.title: Hands install home
HANDS_HOME.description: Directory that contains servers/hands.exe. Leave empty to resolve %LOCALAPPDATA%\AIWander\Hands at runtime (the current user's application-data directory on other systems). Set this at install time so the stdio command can expand.

CPC_ROOT.title: CPC install root (back-compat)
CPC_ROOT.description: Optional. Used as the Hands home only when HANDS_HOME is unset. Older installs can set this instead of HANDS_HOME. Leave empty on a new install.

CPC_CACHE.title: Cache path (back-compat)
CPC_CACHE.description: Optional local Cache directory. When empty, Cache is <Hands home>/cache. v1 is path + skills only — no Cache MCP server.
